scope: Official-source availability and on-disk checkpoint audit. No GPU model loading, generation, equivalence, or latency measured in this report.

draft.scope: Experimental competitor manifest only; not part of product registry or model lock
draft.license_evidence: Apache-2.0 declared by the fixed model card and Hugging Face API metadata; this revision has no separate LICENSE file. Upstream project code is MIT, a separate license.

nominal_target_compatibility.shared_parameters: Installed DFlash v1 bind borrows target embed_tokens and lm_head; use the pinned target tokenizer/template and its token IDs. No independent draft tokenizer is loaded.
nominal_target_compatibility.caveat: Matching config geometry and a model card for the original 9B establish a valid candidate, not proven correctness/quality or acceptance for the quantized MLX conversion. The installed DFlash v1 bind has no comprehensive target validator.

official_loader.path: mlx_vlm.speculative.drafters.load_drafter(kind="dflash") -> installed qwen3_dflash DFlashDraftModel -> bind shared target embeddings/lm_head -> optional official load-time affine quantization -> attach DFlashDrafter to batched Lightning MTP verify/accept/rollback
official_loader.quantization: Official oMLX nn.quantize predicate handles Linear layers with input width divisible by group size; 4-bit/group64 is an explicit supported configuration. Original BF16 checkpoint remains intact. Actual packed parameter bytes and load peak require GPU measurement.
official_loader.block_semantics: Block includes the anchor; block5 gives at most4 proposals, with adaptive mode choosing verified depth. Trained block is16.
official_loader.backend_recommendations: Pinned official project MLX guidance recommends block<=5 for quantized target or draft due to quantized-matmul width efficiency. The model card recommends8/16 for its SGLang B200 backend; those results are not Mac benchmarks.

verification_modes.adaptive: Official measured-cost and acceptance controller chooses verified depth
verification_modes.off: Alias for full-block verification; does not disable DFlash

official_loader.fail_soft_gate: Installed engine_pool catches draft-load exceptions, logs DFlash drafter load raised ... toggle ignored, and continues serving the target. HTTP200 and dflash_enabled=True do not prove DFlash ran. Require successful drafter-loaded log plus set_dflash_drafter / _omlx_drafter and actual draft/verify runtime evidence. Preserve any fallback failure separately.

resource_preflight_estimates_not_measure.omlx_context_bytes_per_row_formula: window * 2 * (draft_layers * 2 * kv_heads * head_dim + hidden + captured_layers * hidden)
resource_preflight_estimates_not_measure.admission: Disk and fixed weight geometry support a bounded dev attempt on24GiB, preferably official4bit load-time draft. Current free memory/load peak/prefill capture transients/target KV and recurrent state/allocator/cache/swap must be measured before formal admission. No zero-swap or no-OOM claim.

messages.content: Return exactly the integer result of 6 times 7.

dev_candidates.draft_quant_enabled_false: BF16 control, subject to actual memory admission

proposed_dev_configuration_not_executed.fairness: Choose independently on dev only, after strict correctness/template/resource verification. Retain all failures and BF16/4bit memory overhead. Freeze checkpoint, environment, mode and chosen parameters before heldout. Compare both default and optimized oMLX transparently; do not generalize baseline-only results to all oMLX capabilities.

required_next_actual_validation: Acquire GPU baton and ensure no model server/download competes with measurements.
Load exact pinned target plus trained draft via existing official oMLX loader; capture load success/failure and actual resident/Metal/process/swap resources.

Compare pinned target tokenized templates and deterministic dev outputs to non-speculative target; retain divergence and strict quality failures rather than promising bitwise equivalence from speculation theory.
Exercise greedy plus supported official nonthinking sampled requests with penalties; verify whether oMLX chooses speculative acceptance or documented fallback, using runtime evidence.
Check cache hits/branch reuse, cancellation, recovery and supported concurrency before frozen formal comparison.
not_claimed: No local speedup conclusion follows from checkpoint availability.
Upstream B200 or other Mac published speedups are not local experiment results.
No need for native MTP tensors does not itself prove this trained draft works.

config_parser_audit.scope: CPU execution of unmodified installed DFlashConfig AST only, substituting unused BaseModelConfig base with object to avoid MLX import/GPU. This is a config parser check, not a runtime model load.

tensor_header_validation.scope: Complete SHA256-verified safetensors file header, tensor shapes/dtypes/contiguous offsets validated without loading arrays.

range_chunks_cleanup_details.scope: Only completed DFlash range chunks after full file SHA256 verification

prepared_local_dev_entrypoints_not_execu.bf16: Use the identical q4 command with base-path <DFLASH_DEV_ROOT>/base-bf16-b5-adaptive only after actual memory admission.
prepared_local_dev_entrypoints_not_execu.scope: Both isolated model_settings.json files and the exact pinned target alias are prepared locally. No server was started. These are dev probes, not the frozen formal benchmark configurations.
